errorCodes.meaning: No pending revocation with this id, or it was started by a different producer.
The revocationId outlived its window. Start a new ceremony.
The assertion did not verify, did not match the challenge bound at start, was not from a credential chosen at start, or did not carry the UV flag. Deliberately one code for all of these.

Re-checked at commit time, the session credential is now the subject's last, because another revocation completed in between. Never returned for a step-up credential. `details.remaining` MAY carry the count.
Re-checked at commit time, the producer no longer holds the administrator standing over the target subject that the start relied on.

AssertionResponse.description: The credential the client returns from `navigator.credentials.get`. Binary fields are base64url-encoded.
AssertionResponse.title: AuthenticatorAssertionResponse (login)

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Acknowledgement of the removed credential. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/auth/passkey/revoke/finish/0.2#response.

credentialId.description: The credential that was removed. Echoed from the server-side binding rather than from the request, so the producer can confirm the ceremony destroyed what they intended.

purpose.description: New in 0.2. What the revoked credential authenticated. `remaining` counts the subject's credentials of this purpose.

remaining.description: How many credentials of the revoked credential's purpose the subject still has. For a session credential never zero — the last-credential guard guarantees it; for a step-up credential it may be zero. Present so whoever just pruned an estate knows what is left without a second round-trip.

subject.description: New in 0.2. The VID the revoked credential was bound to.

schema.description: Submit the user-verification assertion that completes a passkey revocation. On success the auth service unbinds the credential named at start. The payload carries no target — the revocationId is bound to it server-side.

revocationId.description: The revocationId issued by the matching auth/passkey/revoke/start response. Echoed verbatim.

uvCredential.description: AuthenticatorAssertionResponse as returned by navigator.credentials.get over the uvOptions from start. Binary fields base64url-encoded.
